parameters.query: DELETE FROM messages m USING retention_policies p WHERE m.organization_id=p.organization_id AND m.created_at < now()-(p.message_days||' days')::interval; DELETE FROM audit_events a USING retention_policies p WHERE a.organization_id=p.organization_id AND a.created_at < now()-(p.audit_days||' days')::interval; SELECT 1;
